title: Manipulation-check distance distributions
research_question: How much surface variation did each condition produce?
filters: all approved available non-C0 rewrites; manipulation check independent of primary complete-case eligibility
main_observation: Distributions retain each metric's definition; unavailable values are omitted and observed N is exported.
allowed_interpretation: TF-IDF cosine is lexical feature similarity; Jaccard and edit measures describe surface changes.
forbidden_interpretation: Lexical cosine similarity must not be described as semantic preservation.
